about.title: About InkNova
about.p1: InkNova is a print studio for businesses and individuals who want sharp print without a complicated order flow.
about.p2: We collaborate with local printers to give our customers the best price and the best quality.
about.p3: From flyers and business cards to roll-ups and programmes – you pick the format, we handle the rest.

faq.title: FAQ – Questions & answers
faq.intro: Common questions below. Can't find what you need? Contact us.

items.a: Choose product and size, design in the editor, add to cart and pay. We'll send it by post.

items.q: Which file formats do you accept?
items.a: In the editor you upload PNG/JPEG into image slots. We export a print-ready PDF with 3 mm bleed and crop marks.
Yes. At checkout you can pay with Vipps or card via Vipps MobilePay.
It varies by product and day. See lead time on the product page – typically 3–8 business days.

items.q: Do I have a right of withdrawal?
items.a: Products are made to order, so withdrawal rights under § 22 letter e do not apply. You confirm this with a checkbox at checkout. See Returns & complaints.

items.q: How do you process personal data?
items.a: We collect the data needed to deliver print: contact details, delivery address, payment via Vipps and print files. See the privacy policy and cookie page for purposes, recipients and your GDPR rights.

articles.title: Articles
articles.intro: Tips on print, files and design.

items.title: What is a print-ready PDF?
items.excerpt: Bleed, crop marks and why they matter.
items.body: A print-ready PDF is production-ready: 3 mm bleed, crop marks and the right colour profile. When uploading to InkNova, use PDF or PNG. For best results, export with bleed and crop marks from your design tool.

items.title: How to choose the right size
items.excerpt: A-formats, business card sizes and when to go custom.
items.body: A5, A4 and A6 are common for flyers. Business cards have several centimetre options. Posters and flyers can also be ordered in a custom size within the max dimensions on the product page. The price updates when you change size.

items.title: RGB or CMYK – which should you use?
items.excerpt: Screens and print speak different colour languages. Here's how to avoid surprises.
items.body: Your screen shows colour in RGB (red, green, blue – light). Print uses CMYK (cyan, magenta, yellow and black – ink). Some vivid screen colours cannot be matched exactly in print, so the result can look slightly softer. For best control: work in CMYK in a pro design tool, or use our editor and preview before ordering. Small differences between screen and print are normal.

items.title: How sharp do images need to be?
items.excerpt: DPI, pixels and why soft images show up in print.
items.body: For print we recommend images around 300 DPI at the final size. A photo that looks fine on a phone can still be too small for an A4 flyer. Rule of thumb: the larger the print area, the more pixels you need. Prefer original files from a camera or design tool – not screenshots or heavily compressed social media images when you can avoid it.

terms.title: Withdrawal, complaints and claims
terms.intro: At InkNova we want you to be happy with the products you order. Below is information about your rights when buying made-to-order print.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.p1: All products ordered from InkNova are produced to the customer's specifications. This applies when you:
bullets: design the product yourself in our webshop
use our templates and customise them (e.g. replace logo, text or images)
withdrawal.p2: Production starts shortly after the order is placed. Because products are made to order and cannot be resold, the right of withdrawal under the Cancellation Act § 22 letter e does not apply.
withdrawal.p3: Please carefully check design, text, images, colours, measurements and other information before completing your order.

complaint.title: Right to complain
complaint.p1: You have a right to complain under the Consumer Purchases Act if the product has a production defect or differs from what was agreed.
complaint.applies: The right to complain applies if, for example:
appliesList: the product was made with the wrong material or size
the print has a production defect
the item was damaged in delivery due to production or packaging
complaint.notApplies: The right to complain does not apply if the fault is due to:
notAppliesList: typos, layout errors or other issues in a design you submitted, uploaded or approved
errors in finished files provided by the customer
errors or defects in text, logo or images placed in our templates by the customer
colours or graphics you added or changed in a template
minor colour differences between screen and print

how.title: How to complain
how.p1: If you find a fault, contact us as soon as possible and within a reasonable time after discovering it. Send us:
list: order number
a description of the fault
clear photos of the product
how.p2: We assess complaints as quickly as possible. If the complaint is justified, we will normally offer a reprint, fix, price reduction or refund in line with applicable law.

before.title: Important before ordering
before.p1: As a customer you are responsible for the design and content you submit being correct. InkNova does not check or proofread text, layout, spelling or image quality before production — including when using our templates or uploading finished files.
before.p2: By placing an order you confirm that the design has been checked and is ready for production.

salesTerms.title: Terms of sale
salesTerms.intro: These terms apply to purchases in the InkNova webshop. The shop is aimed at customers in Norway.

products.title: Products
products.p1: We sell print products made to your specifications, such as flyers, business cards, posters, stickers, roll-ups and signs.
products.p2: Production starts shortly after payment is confirmed. You are responsible for design, text, images and measurements being correct before you complete the purchase.

prices.title: Prices
prices.p1: All prices are shown in Norwegian kroner (NOK) and include VAT unless clearly stated otherwise. Shipping is shown at checkout before you pay. We reserve the right to correct obvious pricing errors.

order.title: Ordering
order.p1: The order is binding when you have completed checkout, accepted the terms and finished payment. You receive an order confirmation with an order number.
order.p2: We forward the print files and order details to our production partner for printing and shipping.

payment.title: Payment
payment.p1: You can pay with Vipps or card. Payment is processed by Vipps MobilePay. We charge the amount when the order is approved. We do not store card numbers.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.p1: We deliver in Norway. Lead time is shown on the product page and may vary by product and weekday. Shipping is calculated at checkout. Risk in the goods passes to you when delivered to the stated address, unless the law provides otherwise.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.p1: Products are made to order and cannot be resold. The right of withdrawal therefore does not apply, cf. the Cancellation Act § 22 letter e. Full information is under <terms>withdrawal and complaints</terms>. At checkout you must confirm that you are aware of this.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.p1: You have a right to complain under the Consumer Purchases Act for production defects or deviation from what was agreed. How to complain, and what is not covered (for example errors in your own design), is set out in <terms>withdrawal and complaints</terms>.

design.title: Responsibility for design
design.p1: You are responsible for the content you design, upload or place in templates being correct, and that you have the right to use logos, images and text.
design.p2: InkNova does not proofread text, layout, spelling or image quality before production. By ordering you confirm that the design has been checked and is ready for print.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: We process personal data to fulfil the purchase. Read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> for purposes, recipients and your rights.

law.title: Governing law
law.p1: The purchase is governed by Norwegian law. Consumers have mandatory rights under Norwegian consumer legislation. Disputes may be brought before the Norwegian Consumer Authority / Consumer Council and Norwegian courts.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how InkNova processes personal data when you use the webshop, order print or contact us. We follow the GDPR and the Norwegian Personal Data Act.

controller.title: Controller
controller.p1: InkNova is the controller for personal data we collect via the website.
list: InkNova
Email: Kontakt@inknova.no
Norway

data.title: What data we collect
data.p1: We collect information you give us, and technical data needed for the shop to work:
list: Identity and contact: name, email, phone
Delivery: street address, postal code and city in Norway
Order: products, size, quantity, price and print files (PDF)
Payment: payment method and status via Vipps MobilePay. We do not store card numbers
Contact form: name, email and message
Necessary browser storage: cart, design files and pending order

purpose.title: Purposes and legal bases
purpose.p1: We process data only when we have a lawful basis:
list: Contract (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)): receiving and producing the order, taking payment, delivering the goods and answering purchase-related enquiries
Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)): bookkeeping and accounting
Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): optional email marketing and any non-essential cookies
Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)): securing the site, preventing abuse and improving the service without overriding your rights

recipients.title: Who receives the data
recipients.p1: We share data only when needed to deliver the service:
list: Production partner (Copycat Lillestrøm): name, delivery address, product, quantity and print files
Vipps MobilePay: amount, order reference and necessary payment information
Email provider: for order confirmation, production mail and the contact form
Postal/shipping: name and delivery address
recipients.vipps: Vipps MobilePay processes payment data under its own terms. See the <vipps>Vipps privacy policy</vipps>.

retention.title: Retention
retention.p1: We keep data only as long as needed for the purpose, and then as required by law:
list: Order and payment data: in line with the Bookkeeping Act (normally 5 years)
Print files: until production and any complaint are completed
Contact enquiries: until answered, then deleted within a reasonable time (normally within 12 months)
Cart and design in the browser: until you clear them or delete browser data
Marketing consent: until you withdraw consent

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: You can contact us at Kontakt@inknova.no to exercise your GDPR rights:
list: Access to the data we hold about you
Rectification of inaccurate data
Erasure where the law allows
Restriction and objection to certain processing
Data portability for data you have provided
Withdrawing consent without affecting lawful processing before withdrawal
rights.complaint: You may lodge a complaint with the <datatilsynet>Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet)</datatilsynet> if you believe we process data unlawfully.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.p1: We use necessary storage for cart, design and checkout to work. You can read more and change choices on the <cookies>cookies</cookies> page.

security.title: Security
security.p1: We use HTTPS and limit access to personal data to what is needed to fulfil the order. Print files are sent to production by email with attachments. No system is risk-free, but we take reasonable measures to protect the data.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: We may update this policy when the service or the law changes. The date at the top shows when it was last updated. Material changes will be shown on the website.

banner.title: Cookies and privacy
banner.body: We use necessary browser storage for cart, design and checkout. Analytics and marketing are optional and are not used without your consent. Read more in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> and about <cookies>cookies</cookies>.

settings.title: Your choices
settings.intro: Necessary storage cannot be turned off because the shop would not work. Other categories are optional and require consent.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.body: Cart, design files, pending payment and settings needed for the site to work. This is necessary storage and does not require consent.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Helps us understand how the site is used. We do not use analytics tools until you have consented, and this category is off by default.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.body: Used to show or measure relevant marketing. We do not set such cookies without consent.

page.title: Cookies
page.intro: This page explains what storage InkNova uses in your browser, and how you can manage your choices.

what.title: What is this?
what.p1: Cookies and similar technology (for example localStorage and IndexedDB) are small data stored in the browser. Under the Electronic Communications Act and the GDPR you must be informed, and consent is required when the storage is not strictly necessary.

manage.title: How to change your choices
manage.p1: Open <settings>cookie settings</settings> at any time, or delete browser data. Personal data beyond this is described in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
